snippet.title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Beta Launch Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
World of Tanks: HEAT is the first ever hero-driven tank action game. Choose your Agent, personalize your tank, and combine skill and strategy to dominate the battlefield.

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
